muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وإذا قرأت القرآن جعلنا بينك وبين الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة حجابا مستورا﴾: the و is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; إذا is an adverb of future time implying the sense of a condition; ﴿قرأت القرآن﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of genitive (jarr), the adverb being annexed (muḍāf) to it; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بينك﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بين الذين لا يؤمنون﴾ is conjoined to the first adverb; the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; حجابًا is the first object of جعلنا; and مستورًا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حجابًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وجعلنا على قلوبهم أكنة أن يفقهوه وفي آذانهم وقرا﴾: جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of جعلنا; أكنة is the first object of جعلنا; ﴿أن يفقهوه﴾ is in the accusative position as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion to their understanding it" (كراهة أن يفقهوه), or it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from understanding it" (من أن يفقهوه), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أكنة﴾; ﴿في آذانهم وقرا﴾ is conjoined to His words ﴿على قلوبهم أكنة﴾.
﴿وإذا ذكرت ربك في القرآن وحده ولوا على أدبارهم نفورا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time; ﴿ذكرت﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿ذكرت﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); ربك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في القرآن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ذكرت﴾; ﴿وحده﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿ولوا﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿على أدبارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; نفورًا stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the meaning of ولَّوا, or it is a ḥāl, i.e. "fleeing" (نافرين); and it is said: it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿نحن أعلم بما يستمعون به إذ يستمعون إليك﴾: نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause يستمعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستمعون﴾, and the باء is causal; and it is said: ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), as we say: "they listen with mockery" (يستمعون بالهزء), i.e. "mocking" (هازئين); and it is said: the باء is in the sense of the لام; إذ is an adverb of past time attached to ﴿أعلم﴾ or to the first ﴿يستمعون﴾; and the clause ﴿يستمعون إليك﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وإذ هم نجوى﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb conjoined to the ﴿إذ﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿إذ يستمعون﴾, so it is attached to ﴿أعلم﴾ or to the first ﴿يستمعون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and نجوى is the khabar, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf; and it is said: there is no need to assume a muḍāf before the khabar; the clause ﴿هم نجوى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذ يقول الظالمون إن تتبعون إلا رجلا مسحورا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a badal (substitute) for the preceding ﴿إذ﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿وإذ هم نجوى﴾. ﴿يقول الظالمون﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿يقول الظالمون﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إن is negating; تتبعون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the و is the fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رجلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and مسحورًا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجلًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿انظر كيف ضربوا لك الأمثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا﴾: انظر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ضربوا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضربوا﴾; الأمثال is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فضلوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ضربوا﴾, and the فاء is a conjunction; لا is negating; and يستطيعون سبيلًا is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿وقالوا أئذا كنا عظاما ورفاتا﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); إذا is an adverb of future time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "Shall we be resurrected" (أنبعث), or "Shall we be gathered when we are bones and dust" (نحشر إذا كنا عظامًا ورفاتًا), and the apodosis (jawāb) is the very verb to which it is attached; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), عظامًا is its khabar (predicate), and رفاتًا is conjoined to ﴿عظامًا﴾.
﴿أئنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مبعوثون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿خلقا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "created" (مخلوقين), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), from the meaning of the verb and not its wording, i.e. "we shall be raised with a new raising" (نبعث بعثا جديدا); and ﴿جديدا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قل كونوا حجارة أو حديدا﴾: قل is an imperative verb; ﴿كونوا﴾ is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) imperative verb, the و is its noun (ism), and حجارة is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿كونوا حجارة﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and حديدًا is conjoined to حجارة.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿أو خلقا مما يكبر في صدوركم﴾: أو is a conjunction; خلقًا is conjoined to حجارة; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿خلقًا﴾; the clause يكبر is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿في صدوركم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكبر﴾.
﴿فسيقولون من يعيدنا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; the سين is a particle of the future; يقولون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); من is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause يعيدنا is the khabar (predicate).
﴿قل الذي فطركم أول مرة﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb; الذي فطركم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "will bring you back" (يعيدكم), or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "He is the One who created you" (هو الذي فطركم); the clause فطركم is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; and ﴿أول مرة﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿فطركم﴾.
﴿فسينغضون إليك رءوسهم ويقولون متى هو﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; the سين is for the future; ينغضون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينغضون﴾; رءوسهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يقولون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ينغضون﴾; متى is an interrogative noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; and ﴿هو﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿قل عسى أن يكون قريبا﴾: عسى is one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), and its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو); أن together with what follows it is in the position of accusative as the khabar of عسى; the noun of يكون is latent, its implied form being "it" (هو), and قريبًا is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿يوم يدعوكم فتستجيبون بحمده﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر) or "remember (pl.)" (اذكروا); the clause ﴿يدعوكم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿فتستجيبون﴾ is conjoined to يدعوكم; and ﴿بحمده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "praising" (حامدين).
﴿وتظنون إن لبثتم إلا قليلا﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿تظنون﴾ is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إن﴾ is negating; ﴿لبثتم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and ﴿قليلًا﴾ stands in place of an adverb of time, attached to ﴿لبثتم﴾, i.e. "a little time" (زمنًا قليلا), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is its adjective, i.e. "a little tarrying" (لبثًا قليلًا).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وقل لعبادي يقولوا التي هي أحسن﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لعبادي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by an implied lām of command, the omission of the lām being permissible because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the و of the plural is the fāʿil.
Or: ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, and the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, the implied form being: "Say to My servants, 'Say that which is best,' and they will say that which is best" (قل لعبادي قولوا التي هي أحسن يقولوا التي هي أحسن).
Or: ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb turned from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿قولوا﴾, and it was made indeclinable (mabnī) because it occurs in the place of an indeclinable form, so its nūn was dropped.
﴿التي﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يقولوا﴾, or an adjective of an omitted object, i.e. "let them say the word which is best" (يقولوا الكلمةَ التي هي أحسن); ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿أحسن﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿هي أحسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الشيطان ينزغ بينهم﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for His words ﴿يقولوا التي هي أحسن﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿الشيطان﴾ is the noun (ism) of إن, and the clause ﴿ينزغ بينهم﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿إن الشيطان كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle and ﴿الشيطان﴾ is the noun of إن; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿للإنسان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عدوًّا﴾; ﴿عدوًّا﴾ is the khabar of كان, and ﴿مبينًا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عدوًّا﴾; the clause ﴿كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن, and the clause ﴿إن الشيطان كان للإنسان عدوا مبينا﴾ gives the reason for the clause ﴿ينزغ بينهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿ربكم أعلم بكم إن يشأ يرحمكم﴾: ربكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; إن is conditional; ﴿يشأ﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), in the jussive (majzūm); and يرحمكم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), also in the jussive.
﴿أو إن يشأ يعذبكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وما أرسلناك عليهم وكيلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; أرسلناك is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيلًا﴾; and وكيلًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the كاف.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وربك أعلم بمن في السماوات والأرض﴾: the و is a conjunction; ربك is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أعلم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿بمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; and ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولقد فضلنا بعض النبيين على بعض وآتينا داود زبورا﴾: the و is a conjunction; the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); فضلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بعض النبيين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فضلنا﴾; آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil, conjoined to ﴿فضلنا﴾; داود is the first mafʿūl bihi, and زبورًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿قل ادعوا الذين زعمتم من دونه﴾: the clause ﴿ادعوا الذين﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ادعوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause زعمتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the two objects of ﴿زعمتم﴾ are omitted because they are known, the implied form being "you claimed them to be gods" (زعمتموهم آلهة); and ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلا يملكون كشف الضر عنكم ولا تحويلا﴾: the فاء is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is negating; يملكون كشف الضر is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عنكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كشف﴾; the و is a conjunction, لا is negating, and تحويلًا is conjoined to كشف الضر.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿أولئك الذين يدعون يبتغون إلى ربهم الوسيلة﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين يدعون is a badal (substitute) for it; the clause يبتغون is the khabar (predicate), and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى ربهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿الوسيلة﴾; الوسيلة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or ﴿الذين﴾ is the khabar, and the clause يبتغون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يدعون.
﴿أيهم أقرب ويرجون رحمته ويخافون عذابه﴾: ﴿أيهم﴾ is a badal for the fāʿil of يبتغون, and ﴿أي﴾ is relative (mawṣūla), and أقرب is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; and it is said: ﴿أي﴾ is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ, and أقرب is the khabar, the meaning being: they look to see which of them is nearest and seek a means through him, on the assumption of a suppressed verb of suspension (taʿlīq), and ﴿أيهم أقرب﴾ is in the accusative position by the dropping of the preposition; ويرجون رحمته is conjoined to يبتغون; يرجون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and رحمته is the mafʿūl bihi; and ويخافون عذابه is conjoined to يرجون رحمته.
﴿إن عذاب ربك كان محذورا﴾: the reason for the fear; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, عذاب is its noun (ism), and the clause كان is its khabar; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو), and محذورًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وإن من قرية إلا نحن مهلكوها قبل يوم القيامة أو معذبوها عذابا شديدا﴾: the و is resumptive; إن is negating; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; قرية is a mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); نحن is a mubtadaʾ and مهلكوها is its khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is the khabar of قرية; in ﴿قبل يوم القيامة﴾ the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مهلكوها﴾; the clause ﴿وإن من قرية...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and معذبوها is conjoined to ﴿مهلكوها﴾; عذابا stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and شديدًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا﴾: كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and ذلك is its noun (ism); ﴿في الكتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسطورًا﴾; and مسطورًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وما منعنا أن نرسل بالآيات إلا أن كذب بها الأولون﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; منعنا is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن نرسل﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the second object of ﴿منع﴾; in ﴿بالآيات﴾ the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, or a genuine one denoting accompaniment (mulābasa), the object being omitted, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being: "Nothing prevented Us from sending a prophet in the state of being accompanied by the signs"; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the second أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of منع; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كذب﴾; and الأولون is the fāʿil.
﴿وآتينا ثمود الناقة مبصرة فظلموا بها﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil; ثمود is the first mafʿūl bihi, and الناقة is the second mafʿūl bihi; مبصرة is a ḥāl; in ﴿فظلموا﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, and ظلموا is a verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it.
﴿وما نرسل بالآيات إلا تخويفا﴾: the و is circumstantial; ما is negating; نرسل is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; in ﴿بالآيات﴾ the باء is a connective (redundant) preposition, or a genuine one denoting accompaniment; إلا is a particle of restriction; and تخويفًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a maṣdar in the accusative position as a ḥāl, either from the fāʿil, i.e. "frightening by means of them" (مخوفين بها), or from the object, i.e. "made a means of frightening" (مخوفًا بها).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وإذ قلنا لك إن ربك أحاط بالناس﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ربك is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿أحاط بالناس﴾ is its khabar (predicate).
﴿وما جعلنا الرؤيا التي أريناك إلا فتنة للناس﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; جعلنا الرؤيا is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; أريناك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); فتنة is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جعلنا﴾; and ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿فتنة﴾.
﴿والشجرة الملعونة في القرآن﴾: conjoined to الرؤيا; ﴿الملعونة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of it; and ﴿في القرآن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ونخوفهم فما يزيدهم إلا طغيانا كبيرا﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نخوفهم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿فما﴾ the فاء is a conjunction and ما is negating; يزيدهم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "Our frightening" (تخويفنا); إلا is a particle of restriction; طغيانًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; and كبيرًا is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإذ قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); ﴿قلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿للملائكة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلنا﴾; اسجدوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil, and the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿لآدم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اسجدوا﴾; in ﴿فسجدوا﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, and سجدوا is a verb and its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of exception; إبليس is excepted (mustathnā) by ﴿إلا﴾, the exception being connected (muttaṣil), on the view that Iblīs was originally of the angels; and it is said: it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), because he is not of them.
﴿قال أأسجد لمن خلقت طينا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسجد﴾; the clause خلقت is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; طينًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, its governing word (ʿāmil) being ﴿أأسجد﴾, or from the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) of this relative noun, i.e. "You created him as clay" (خلقته طينًا), so that its governing word is خلقته, as though he said: "originating from clay" (متأصلًا من طين); and it is said: it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from clay" (من طين); and it is said: it is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿قال أرأيتك هذا الذي كرمت علي﴾: in ﴿أرأيتك﴾ the hamza is interrogative; رأى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; the تاء is the fāʿil (agent); the كاف is for emphasising the address and has no grammatical position; ﴿هذا﴾ is the first object; the relative noun is an adjective (ṣifa) or a badal (substitute) of it; and the second object is omitted because the ṣila (relative clause) indicates it, i.e. "Tell me about this one whom You have honoured above me by commanding me to prostrate to him: why have You honoured him above me?"
﴿لئن أخرتن إلى يوم القيامة لأحتنكن ذريته إلا قليلا﴾: the لام paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أخرتني is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the nūn being the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿إلى يوم القيامة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرتني﴾; in ﴿لأحتنكن﴾ the لام occurs in the answer to the oath, and أحتنكن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); ذريته is the mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of exception, and قليلًا is excepted from ﴿ذريته﴾, in the accusative; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال اذهب فمن تبعك منهم﴾: اذهب is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); in ﴿فمن﴾ the فاء is resumptive, and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); تبعك is a past verb, the fāʿil is latent, and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿تبعك﴾ is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فإن جهنم جزاؤكم جزاء موفورا﴾: the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, جهنم is its noun (ism), and جزاؤكم is its khabar (predicate); جزاء is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of a verb indicated by جزاؤكم, i.e. "you will be recompensed with a recompense" (تجزون جزاء), or it is made accusative by the maṣdar; and it is said: it is a preparatory ḥāl (ḥāl muwaṭṭiʾa); and it is said: a tamyīz (specification); موفورًا is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿فمن تبعك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿واستفزز من استطعت منهم بصوتك وأجلب عليهم بخيلك ورجلك﴾: the و is a conjunction; استفزز is a second command to Satan; ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, the object of استفزز; the clause استطعت is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position, and the object of استطعت is omitted, its implied form being "whomever you are able to incite" (من استطعت أن تستفزه); ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿بصوتك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استفزز﴾; أجلب is a third command; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿بخيلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أجلب﴾; and رجلك is conjoined to بخيلك.
﴿وشاركهم في الأموال والأولاد وعدهم﴾: ﴿وشاركهم في﴾ is a fourth command, and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في الأموال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شاركهم﴾; ﴿عدهم﴾ is a fifth command, and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما يعدهم الشيطان إلا غرورا﴾: the و is circumstantial or parenthetical; ما is negating; يعدهم الشيطان is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); غرورًا is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "except a deluding promise" (إلا وعدًا غرورًا); and it is said: it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he does not promise them and raise their hopes except for the sake of delusion"; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or it is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿إن عبادي ليس لك عليهم سلطان وكفى بربك وكيلا﴾: an explanatory (taʿlīliyya) clause for the command to promise, i.e. "We only command you to do that because We know that you have no authority over Our righteous servants"; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, عبادي is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar of ﴿ليس﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of سلطان; سلطان is the postponed noun of ليس; كفى is a past verb, the باء is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) on the fāʿil (agent); and وكيلًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿ربكم الذي يزجي لكم الفلك في البحر﴾: the clause is an explanation (taʿlīl) setting out the power of Allah the Exalted; ربكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause يزجي is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يزجي﴾; الفلك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لتبتغوا من فضله﴾: the لام is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); تبتغوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تبتغوا﴾, i.e. "that you may seek profit from His bounty".
﴿إنه كان بكم رحيما﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the هاء is its noun (ism), and the clause كان is its khabar; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رحيمًا﴾; and رحيمًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿وإذا مسكم الضر في البحر ضل من تدعون إلا إياه﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time implying the sense of a condition; the clause مسكم is muḍāf ilayhi; the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and الضر is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while you are at sea"; the clause ضل has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿ضل﴾; the clause تدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿إلا إياه﴾ is a connected (muttaṣil) exception; and it is said: disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), i.e. "the gods you call upon fail to come to your aid, but Allah alone is the One in whom alone you place your hope".
﴿فلما نجاكم إلى البر أعرضتم وكان الإنسان كفورا﴾: لما is a non-jussive conditional particle; نجاكم is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); ﴿إلى البر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجاكم﴾; أعرضتم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, الإنسان is its noun (ism), and كفورا is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿أفأمنتم أن يخسف بكم جانب البر﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the فاء conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being: "Were you saved, and so felt secure, and did your rescue lead you to turn away?"; أمنتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿أن يخسف﴾ is an interpreted maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from His causing to swallow" (من أن يخسف), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمنتم﴾; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by you", so the باء is for accompaniment, or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يخسف﴾, and the باء is causal; and ﴿جانب البر﴾ is the object of يخسف.
﴿أو يرسل عليكم حاصبا﴾: أو is a conjunction; يرسل is conjoined to يخسف; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرسل﴾; and حاصبًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ثم لا تجدوا لكم وكيلا﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); لا is negating; تجدوا is likewise conjoined to يرسل; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of ﴿وكيلًا﴾ and was placed before it; and وكيلًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿أم أمنتم أن يعيدكم فيه تارة أخرى﴾: أم is a conjunction; أمنتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb in ﴿أن يعيدكم﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمنتم﴾; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعيدكم﴾; ﴿تارة﴾ is an adverb, also attached to ﴿يعيدكم﴾; and أخرى is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فيرسل عليكم قاصفا من الريح فيغرقكم بما كفرتم﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; يرسل is conjoined to أن يعيدكم; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرسل﴾; قاصفًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من الريح﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective; the فاء is a conjunction, and يغرقكم is conjoined to يرسل; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغرقكم﴾, and ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), i.e. "because of your disbelief".
﴿ثم لا تجدوا لكم علينا به تبيعا﴾: ثم is a conjunction; لا تجدوا is conjoined to يغرقكم; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of ﴿تبيعًا﴾ and was placed before it; ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, likewise attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبيعًا﴾; and it is said: ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تبيعا﴾.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿ولقد كرمنا بني آدم وحملناهم في البر والبحر﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the لام is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); كرمنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بني آدم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حملناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, conjoined to كرمنا; and ﴿في البر والبحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملناهم﴾.
﴿ورزقناهم من الطيبات وفضلناهم على كثير ممن خلقنا تفضيلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; رزقناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, conjoined to كرمنا; ﴿من الطيبات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رزقناهم﴾; فضلناهم is conjoined to كرمنا; ﴿على كثير﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فضلناهم﴾; ﴿ممن خلقنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿كثير﴾; the clause خلقنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; and تفضيلًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿يوم ندعو كل أناس بإمامهم﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); ندعو is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); كل أناس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ندعو is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿بإمامهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ندعو﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "marked and known by their leader".
﴿فمن أوتي كتابه بيمينه﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; من is conditional, or relative, in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); أوتي is a past verb constructed for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; كتابه is the second mafʿūl bihi; and بيمينه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوتي﴾.
﴿فأولئك يقرءون كتابهم﴾: the فاء is the linking one; أولئك is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause يقرءون is the khabar (predicate); كتابهم is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause أولئك is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), or the khabar of the relative noun.
﴿ولا يظلمون فتيلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is negating; ﴿يظلمون﴾ is an imperfect verb constructed for that whose agent is not named, and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil; and ﴿فتيلا﴾ stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a wrong the size of a date-stone thread" (ظلمًا قدر الفتيل).

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿ومن كان في هذه أعمى﴾: the و is a conjunction; من is conditional or relative; كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, its noun (ism) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to ﴿مَن﴾, or the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); أعمى is the khabar (predicate) of كان; and ﴿في هذه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كان﴾.
﴿فهو في الآخرة أعمى وأضل سبيلا﴾: the فاء is the linking one; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في الآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); أعمى is the khabar; أضل is conjoined to أعمى; and سبيلًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وإن كادوا ليفتنونك عن الذي أوحينا إليك لتفتري علينا غيره﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is lightened from the heavy (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla) and inoperative (muhmala); كادوا is a defective past verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), and the و is its noun (ism); the لام is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); the clause ﴿يفتنونك﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كادوا; ﴿عن الذي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفتنونك﴾; the clause أوحينا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾; in ﴿لتفتري﴾ the لام is the causal lām, and تفتري is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تفتري﴾; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); and غيره is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإذا لاتخذوك خليلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذًا is a particle of requital and answer, assumed to stand for the conditional ﴿لو﴾, i.e. "and if you had followed what they wanted"; the لام occurs in the answer to the condition assumed with ﴿لو﴾; the كاف is the first mafʿūl bihi, and خليلًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿ولولا أن ثبتناك لقد كدت تركن إليهم شيئا قليلا﴾: لولا is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd); أن and what falls within its scope form a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the لام is the answer of لولا; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); كدت is a past verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), the تاء is its noun (ism), and the clause تركن is its khabar; ﴿إليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركن﴾; and ﴿شيئا﴾ stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the sense of inclining, i.e. "a little of inclining".

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿إذا لأذقناك ضعف الحياة وضعف الممات ثم لا تجد لك علينا نصيرا﴾: إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, assumed to stand for the conditional ﴿لو﴾, i.e. "and if you had followed what they wanted"; the لام occurs in the answer to the condition assumed with ﴿لو﴾; أذقناك is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ضعف is the second object, and الحياة is muḍāf ilayhi; something omitted must be assumed, i.e. "double the punishment of life and double the punishment of death"; ثم is a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); لا is negating; تجد is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجد; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نصيرًا﴾; and نصيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿وإن كادوا ليستفزونك من الأرض ليخرجوك منها﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is lightened from the heavy (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla) and inoperative (muhmala); كادوا is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), and the و is its noun (ism); the لام is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); the clause يستفزونك is the khabar (predicate) of كادوا; ﴿من الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستفزونك﴾; in ليخرجوك the لام is a preposition, and يخرجوك is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the لام; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يستفزونك﴾; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرجوك﴾, and the pronoun refers to the land.
﴿وإذا لا يلبثون خلافك إلا قليلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); لا is negating; يلبثون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); خلافك is an adverb attached to ﴿يلبثون﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and قليلًا is an adjective of an omitted adverb, i.e. "a little time" (زمانًا قليلًا), or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a little tarrying" (لبثًا قليلًا).

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿سنة من قد أرسلنا قبلك من رسلنا﴾: سنة is made accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), or by an omitted verb, i.e. "follow the way" (اتبع سنة); and it is said: by removal of the preposition, i.e. "like the way of those We sent" (كسنة من قد أرسلنا); من is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); قبلك is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; and ﴿من رسلنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا تجد لسنتنا تحويلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is negating; تجد is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿لسنتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted in the accusative as the second object of ﴿تجد﴾; and تحويلا is the first object.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿أقم الصلاة لدلوك الشمس إلى غسق الليل﴾: أقم الصلاة is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿لدلوك﴾ the لام is a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقم﴾; ﴿إلى غسق الليل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿أقم﴾, marking the end-point of the establishment of prayer, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الصلاة, i.e. "establish it extending to the darkness of the night".
﴿وقرآن الفجر إن قرآن الفجر كان مشهودا﴾: the و is a conjunction; قرآن is conjoined to الصلاة, or is accusative by way of incitement (al-ighrāʾ); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, قرآن is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿كان مشهودًا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); كان is a defective, abrogating past verb, مشهودًا is the khabar of كان, and the noun of كان is latent, its implied form being "it" (هو); and the clause ﴿إن قرآن...﴾ etc. gives the reason for the command.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿ومن الليل فتهجد به نافلة لك﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿من الليل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تهجد﴾, or to something omitted, i.e. "rise for a rising in the night" (قم قومة من الليل); and it is said: they are attached to a verb indicated by the meaning of the speech, its implied form being "and stay awake in the night with the Qur'an" (واسهر من الليل بالقرآن); the فاء is a conjunction; تهجد is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تهجد﴾; نافلة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of نافلة; and it is said: attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿عسى أن يبعثك ربك مقاما محمودا﴾: ﴿عسى﴾ is one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), and its noun (ism) is latent; ﴿أن يبعثك﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿ربك﴾ is the fāʿil of يبعثك; ﴿مقامًا﴾ is accusative as an adverb, i.e. "He will raise you in a station" (يبعثك في مقام), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because ﴿يبعثك﴾ means "He will set you up" (يقيمك), or it is a ḥāl, i.e. "He will raise you possessing a station" (يبعثك ذا مقام); and ﴿محمودًا﴾ is an adjective of ﴿مقامًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وقل رب أدخلني مدخل صدق وأخرجني مخرج صدق﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative particle omitted; أدخلني is a verb of supplication, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the ياء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مدخل﴾ stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī). ﴿صدق﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أخرجني مخرج صدق﴾ is conjoined to the parallel clause.
﴿واجعل لي من لدنك سلطانا نصيرا﴾: ﴿واجعل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أدخلني﴾ and ﴿أخرجني﴾; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of ﴿اجعل﴾; سلطانًا is the first object of ﴿اجعل﴾, and نصيرًا is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿من لدنك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿سلطانًا﴾, or attached to what the first is attached to.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وقل جاء الحق وزهق الباطل﴾: the clause جاء الحق is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl), and زهق الباطل is conjoined to it.
﴿إن الباطل كان زهوقا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, الباطل is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿كان﴾ is its khabar (predicate); كان is a defective, abrogating past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), and زهوقًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿وننزل من القرآن ما هو شفاء ورحمة للمؤمنين﴾: the و is a conjunction; ننزل is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); ﴿من القرآن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to ﴿ننزل﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and شفاء is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; رحمة is conjoined to شفاء; and ﴿للمؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شفاء﴾.
﴿ولا يزيد الظالمين إلا خسارا﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لا is negating; يزيد الظالمين is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and خسارًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿وإذا أنعمنا على الإنسان أعرض ونأى بجانبه﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb of future time; ﴿أنعمنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿أنعمنا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿على الإنسان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنعمنا﴾; the clause ﴿أعرض﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; نأى is conjoined to أعرض; and ﴿بجانبه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نأى﴾.
﴿وإذا مسه الشر كان يئوسا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the clause مسه الشر is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿كان﴾ has no grammatical position; the noun (ism) of كان is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), and يئوسًا is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿قل كل يعمل على شاكلته﴾: كل is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يعمل is the khabar (predicate); ﴿على شاكلته﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعمل﴾.
﴿فربكم أعلم بمن هو أهدى سبيلا﴾: the فاء is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ربكم is the mubtadaʾ and أعلم is its khabar; ﴿بمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and أهدى is a khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; and سبيلًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿ويسألونك عن الروح﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; يسألونك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عن الروح﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسألونك﴾.
﴿قل الروح من أمر ربي﴾: الروح is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من أمر ربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿وما أوتيتم من العلم إلا قليلا﴾: the و is a conjunction or circumstantial; ما is negating; أوتيتم is a past verb constructed for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿من العلم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوتيتم﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and قليلًا is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أوتيتم﴾, i.e. "a little thing" (شيئًا قليلًا).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿ولئن شئنا لنذهبن بالذي أوحينا إليك﴾: the و is a conjunction; the لام paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; شئنا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the لام occurs in the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "We would take it away" (ذهبنا به); ﴿بالذي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نذهبن﴾; the clause ﴿أوحينا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; and ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾.
﴿ثم لا تجد لك به علينا وكيلا﴾: ثم is a conjunction; لا is negating; تجد is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لك﴾ and ﴿به﴾ are prepositions with their genitive nouns, attached to an omitted second object of ﴿تجد﴾; ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيلًا﴾; and وكيلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿إلا رحمة من ربك﴾: ﴿رحمة﴾ is accusative as a connected (muttaṣil) exception; or the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), so that ﴿إلا﴾ is in the sense of "but" (لكن); or ﴿رحمة﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being "We preserved it for you out of mercy" (حفظناه عليك للرحمة); or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "but We showed you mercy" (ولكن رحمناك رحمة). ﴿من ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة.
﴿إن فضله كان عليك كبيرا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, فضله is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿كان﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿كبيرًا﴾; and كبيرًا is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿قل لئن اجتمعت الإنس والجن على أن يأتوا بمثل هذا القرآن﴾: the لام paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; اجتمعت is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); الإنس is the fāʿil (agent), and الجن is conjoined to الإنس; in ﴿أن يأتوا﴾, أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "backing and helping one another"; ﴿بمثل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتوا﴾; ﴿هذا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and القرآن is a badal (substitute).
﴿لا يأتون بمثله﴾: لا is negating; the clause يأتون is the answer to the oath; يأتون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the و is the fāʿil; and ﴿بمثله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتون﴾.
﴿ولو كان بعضهم لبعض ظهيرا﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لو﴾ is the connective lau (waṣliyya, "even if"); كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and بعضهم is the noun (ism) of كان; ﴿لبعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظهيرًا﴾; ظهيرًا is the khabar (predicate) of كان; and the clause ﴿لو كان...﴾ etc. is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿ولقد صرفنا للناس في هذا القرآن من كل مثل﴾: the و is a conjunction; the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); صرفنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿في هذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صرفنا﴾; القرآن is a badal (substitute); and ﴿من كل مثل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of the omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "of every meaning that is like a parable in its rarity and beauty".
﴿فأبى أكثر الناس إلا كفورا﴾: ﴿فأبى﴾ is conjoined to صرفنا; ﴿أكثر الناس﴾ is the fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and كفورًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿وقالوا لن نؤمن لك حتى تفجر لنا من الأرض ينبوعا﴾: the و is a conjunction; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative (naṣb) and of the future, and نؤمن is made accusative by it; the fāʿil of ﴿نؤمن﴾ is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نؤمن﴾; حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; تفجر is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿نؤمن﴾; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تفجر﴾; and ينبوعًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿أو تكون لك جنة من نخيل وعنب فتفجر الأنهار خلالها تفجيرا﴾: أو is a conjunction; ﴿تكون﴾ is conjoined to تفجر; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of تكون, and جنة is its postponed noun (ism); in ﴿فتفجر﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, and تفجر is conjoined to تكون, its fāʿil (agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); الأنهار is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿خلالها﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being in its midst"; and تفجيرًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿أو تسقط السماء كما زعمت علينا كسفا﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; تسقط is conjoined to what preceded; السماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the كاف is a noun in the sense of "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi; or the كاف is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تسقط﴾; and كسفًا is a ḥāl from السماء.
﴿أو تأتي بالله والملائكة قبيلا﴾: ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأتي﴾; الملائكة is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; and قبيلًا is a ḥāl from ﴿الله والملائكة﴾ or from one of them.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿أو يكون لك بيت من زخرف﴾: ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of يكون; بيت is the postponed noun (ism) of يكون; and ﴿من زخرف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بيت.
﴿أو ترقى في السماء﴾: أو is a conjunction; ترقى is conjoined to what preceded; and ﴿في السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترقى﴾.
﴿ولن نؤمن لرقيك حتى تنزل علينا كتابا نقرؤه﴾: the و is a conjunction; لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative (naṣb) and of the future; نؤمن is accusative by ﴿لن﴾, its fāʿil (agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); لرقيك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نؤمن﴾; حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; تنزل is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تنزل﴾; كتابًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause نقرؤه is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتابًا﴾, or an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara) from the ﴿نا﴾ in ﴿علينا﴾.
﴿قل سبحان ربي هل كنت إلا بشرا رسولا﴾: قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); سبحان stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb; ربي is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); هل is an interrogative particle whose meaning is negation and disapproval; كنت is a defective past verb, and the تاء is its noun (ism); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشرًا is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كنت﴾, and رسولًا is a naʿt; or بشرا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and رسولا is the khabar of ﴿كنت﴾.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿وما منع الناس أن يؤمنوا إذ جاءهم الهدى﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ما is negating; منع is a past verb; الناس is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of منع; إذ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منع﴾ or to ﴿يؤمنوا﴾; and the clause ﴿جاءهم الهدى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إلا أن قالوا أبعث الله بشرا رسولا﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of منع; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); بعث الله is a verb and its fāʿil; بشرًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from رسولًا, because it was a naʿt (adjective) of it and was placed before it; and رسولًا is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿قل لو كان في الأرض ملائكة يمشون مطمئنين﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb; لو is conditional; كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان, and ملائكة is its postponed noun (ism); the clause يمشون is an adjective (ṣifa) of ملائكة; and مطمئنين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and it is said: ﴿كان﴾ is complete (tāmma), and ملائكة is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿لنزلنا عليهم من السماء ملكا رسولا﴾: the لام occurs in the answer to لو; نزلنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نزلنا﴾; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿نزلنا﴾; ﴿ملكًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and رسولًا is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿قل كفى بالله شهيدا بيني وبينكم﴾: كفى is a past verb; the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿الله﴾ is genitive by the باء in form, and in position it is the fāʿil (agent) of كفى; ﴿شهيدًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification); ﴿بيني﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شهيدًا﴾; and ﴿بينكم﴾ is conjoined to the first adverb.
﴿إنه كان بعباده خبيرا بصيرا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the هاء is its noun (ism), and the clause كان is its khabar (predicate); خبيرًا بصيرًا are two predicates of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿ومن يهد الله﴾: the و is resumptive; من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted object of ﴿يهد﴾; ﴿يهد﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فهو المهتد﴾: the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and المهتدي is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿هو المهتد﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾. The clause ﴿ومن يهد الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source first parses من as a fronted object of يهد and then calls the protasis and apodosis the khabar of من, which presupposes من as mubtadaʾ; translated as written.]
﴿ومن يضلل فلن تجد لهم أولياء من دونه﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the one before it; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أولياء﴾; and ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ونحشرهم يوم القيامة على وجوههم عميا وبكما وصما﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; نحشرهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يوم القيامة is an adverb attached to ﴿نحشرهم﴾; ﴿على وجوههم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the هاء in ﴿نحشرهم﴾; and ﴿عميًا﴾ and what is conjoined to it are likewise aḥwāl (circumstantials).
﴿مأواهم جهنم كلما خبت زدناهم سعيرا﴾: ﴿مأواهم جهنم﴾ is a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, composed of a mubtadaʾ and a khabar; in ﴿كلما﴾, ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in place of an adverb of time, attached to ﴿زدناهم﴾ and implying the sense of a condition, and ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause ﴿خبت﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by annexation, the implied form being "every abating" (كلَّ خبوٍ), on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "every time of abating" (كلَّ وقتِ خبوٍ). Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified by what follows, in the sense of ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, the implied form being "every time it abates in it" (كلَّ وقتٍ خبت فيه), so that the clause ﴿خبت﴾ is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿زدناهم﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil, the هاء is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the ميم is the sign of the plural; ﴿سعيرًا﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿زدناهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause ﴿كلما خبت زدناهم سعيرا﴾ is a ḥāl from جهنم in the position of accusative, or it is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿ذلك جزاؤهم بأنهم كفروا بآياتنا﴾: ذلك is a demonstrative, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and جزاؤهم is its khabar (predicate); in ﴿بأنهم﴾, أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of genitive by the باء, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جزاؤهم﴾; or ﴿جزاؤهم﴾ is a badal (substitute) for ﴿ذلك﴾, and ﴿بأنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause كفروا is the khabar of أن; and ﴿بآياتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفروا﴾.
﴿وقالوا أئذا كنا عظاما ورفاتا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); إذا is an adverb of future time; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), عظامًا is its khabar, and رفاتًا is conjoined to ﴿عظامًا﴾.
﴿أئنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and of deeming unlikely (al-istibʿād); إن is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مبعوثون is the khabar of إن; ﴿خلقًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "created" (مخلوقين), or it stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), from the meaning of the verb and not its wording, i.e. "we shall be raised with a new raising" (نبعث بعثًا جديدًا); and ﴿جديدًا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿أولم يروا أن الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض قادر على أن يخلق مثلهم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the و conjoins to something omitted; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of يروا; الذي is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿الله﴾; the clause ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; قادر is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿على أن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادر﴾; and مثلهم is an adjective of the omitted object, i.e. "a creation like them" (خلقًا مثلهم).
﴿وجعل لهم أجلا لا ريب فيه﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿جعل لهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أو لم يروا﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object of جعل; أجلًا is the first object of جعل; in ﴿لا ريب فيه﴾ the clause is an adjective of ﴿أجلًا﴾; لا is the lā of generic negation, ريب is its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar.
﴿فأبى الظالمون إلا كفورا﴾: ﴿فأبى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جعل﴾; الظالمون is the fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and كفورًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿قل لو أنتم تملكون خزائن رحمة ربي﴾: لو is conditional. أنتم is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of the omitted verb indicated by what follows it. The clause of the omitted verb is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). تملكون is a verb and its fāʿil. The clause ﴿تملكون﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿خزائن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿قل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا لأمسكتم خشية الإنفاق﴾: إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); in ﴿لأمسكتم﴾ the لام occurs in the answer to لو, and the clause has no grammatical position; and خشية الإنفاق is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿وكان الإنسان قتورا﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); كان is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, الإنسان is its noun (ism), and قتورا is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا موسى تسع آيات بينات﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the لام is the answer to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); موسى is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), تسع آيات is the second mafʿūl bihi, and بينات is an adjective (ṣifa) in the genitive.
﴿فاسأل بني إسرائيل إذ جاءهم﴾: the فاء is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that reveals an omitted condition); بني إسرائيل is the mafʿūl bihi; إذ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آتينا﴾; the clause ﴿جاءهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿فقال له﴾ is conjoined to something implied, i.e. "when he came to them and conveyed the message to them".
﴿فقال له فرعون إني لأظنك يا موسى مسحورا﴾: ﴿فقال له فرعون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قال﴾; in ﴿وإني﴾, إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle and the ياء is its noun (ism); the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); أظنك is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi; in ﴿يا موسى﴾, يا is a vocative particle, and موسى is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun in the position of accusative; and مسحورًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿قال لقد علمت ما أنزل هؤلاء إلا رب السماوات والأرض بصائر﴾: قال is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the لام is the answer to the omitted oath; علمت is a verb and its fāʿil; ما is negating; أنزل is a past verb; هؤلاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. the signs that you brought; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رب السماوات والأرض is the fāʿil; and بصائر is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿هؤلاء﴾.
﴿وإني لأظنك يا فرعون مثبورا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the ياء is its noun (ism); the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause أظنك is the khabar (predicate) of إن; يا فرعون is a vocative; and مثبورًا is the second object of أظنك.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿فأراد أن يستفزهم من الأرض﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; أراد is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), i.e. Pharaoh; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what falls within its scope is the object of أراد; and ﴿من الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستفزهم﴾.
﴿فأغرقناه ومن معه جميعا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; أغرقناه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in ﴿ومَن﴾ the و is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and من is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or it is conjoined to the هاء; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb of place, the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, with no grammatical position; and جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿وقلنا من بعده لبني إسرائيل﴾: the و is a conjunction; قلنا is conjoined to what preceded; ﴿من بعده﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿لبني إسرائيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلنا﴾.
﴿اسكنوا الأرض فإذا جاء وعد الآخرة جئنا بكم لفيفا﴾: the clause اسكنوا is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); الأرض is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); in ﴿فإذا﴾ the فاء is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb of future time; جاء وعد الآخرة is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿جئنا﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جئنا﴾; and لفيفًا is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿وبالحق أنزلناه وبالحق نزل﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلناه﴾, and the باء is causal; or it is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of أنزلناه, i.e. "accompanied by the truth" (متلبسا بالحق), or from its fāʿil (agent), i.e. "We being accompanied by the truth" (متلبسين بالحق), the باء being for accompaniment (mulābasa); ﴿أنزلناه﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نزل﴾, and the باء is causal; or it is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of نزل, the باء being for accompaniment.
﴿وما أرسلناك إلا مبشرا ونذيرا﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is negating; أرسلناك is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); مبشرًا is a ḥāl, and نذيرًا is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t: ﴿وقرآنا فرقناه لتقرأه على الناس على مكث ونزلناه تنزيلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; قرآنًا is accusative by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it, and the clause of the omitted verb is conjoined to the clause ﴿أنزلناه﴾. فرقناه is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿فرقناه﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. In ﴿لتقرأه﴾ the لام is causal, and تقرأه is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فرقناه﴾; فرقناه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿على الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقرأه﴾; ﴿على مكث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "slowly and deliberately"; نزلناه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿تنزيلا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿قل آمنوا به أو لا تؤمنوا﴾: the clause آمنوا is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); in أو لا تؤمنوا, أو is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive (nāhiya), and تؤمنوا is jussive (majzūm) by لا.
﴿إن الذين أوتوا العلم من قبله إذا يتلى عليهم يخرون للأذقان سجدا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and الذين is its noun (ism); the clause أوتوا العلم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿العلم﴾ is the second object of ﴿أوتوا﴾, and the first is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the و in ﴿أوتوا﴾; ﴿من قبله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); إذا is an adverb of future time attached to ﴿يخرون﴾; the clause يتلى is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتلى﴾; the clause يخرون has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of إذا; للأذقان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرون﴾; and سجدًا is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t: ﴿ويقولون سبحان ربنا إن كان وعد ربنا لمفعولا﴾: the و is a conjunction; يقولون is conjoined to يخرون; سبحان stands in place of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb; ربنا is muḍāf ilayhi; إن is lightened from the heavy (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla) and inoperative (muhmala); وعد ربنا is the noun (ism) of كان; the لام is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); and مفعولًا is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿ويخرون للأذقان يبكون﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it, and the clause يبكون is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿ويزيدهم خشوعا﴾: the و conjoins to يبكون; يزيدهم is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the هاء is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and خشوعًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿قل ادعوا الله أو ادعوا الرحمن﴾: the clause ادعوا الله is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ادعوا is conjoined to the first ادعوا; and الرحمن is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أيا ما تدعوا فله الأسماء الحسنى﴾: أيًّا is conditional, a fronted object in the accusative; ما is connective (ṣila) and emphatic; تدعوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); the فاء links the apodosis; ﴿له﴾ is a fronted khabar (predicate) and ﴿الأسماء﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and الحسنى is an adjective (ṣifa); and it is said: ما is conditional, and the two conditional particles are combined for emphasis.
﴿ولا تجهر بصلاتك ولا تخافت بها وابتغ بين ذلك سبيلا﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تجهر is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لا﴾, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ولا تخافت is conjoined to ولا تجهر; ابتغ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of ﴿سبيلًا﴾; ﴿ذلك﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and سبيلًا is the object of ابتغ.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿وقل الحمد لله الذي لم يتخذ ولدا﴾: the clause الحمد لله is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); الحمد is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); الذي is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause لم يتخذ ولدًا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولم يكن له شريك في الملك﴾: conjoined to لم يتخذ; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (qalb) and of the jussive; يكن is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿يكن﴾; and شريك is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ولم يكن له ولي من الذل وكبره تكبيرا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿من الذل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ولي﴾; كبره is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is conjoined to قل; and تكبيرًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) for emphasis.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿سبحان الذي أسرى بعبده ليلا من المسجد الحرام إلى المسجد الأقصى الذي باركنا حوله﴾: سبحان: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb; ﴿الذي﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أسرى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿بعبده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسرى﴾; ﴿ليلًا﴾ is an adverb of time, also attached to ﴿أسرى﴾; ﴿من المسجد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "starting"; ﴿إلى المسجد الأقصى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "ending at the mosque"; الأقصى is a naʿt (adjective) of المسجد, and الذي a second naʿt; باركنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿باركنا﴾ is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; and ﴿حوله﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿باركنا﴾.
﴿لنريه من آياتنا﴾: the lām is for giving the reason; نريه is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu"; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and that is so that We might show him"; ﴿من آياتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نريه﴾, and min is partitive.
﴿إنه هو السميع البصير﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and the hāʾ its noun (ism); السميع is the khabar of inna, البصير a second khabar, and ﴿هو﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, السميع the khabar of ﴿هو﴾ and البصير a second khabar, the clause ﴿هو السميع البصير﴾ being the khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿وآتينا موسى الكتاب وجعلناه هدى لبني إسرائيل﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is conjunctive, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿سبحان الذي أسرى﴾; آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); موسى is a first object and الكتاب a second object; ﴿جعلناه﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, the hāʾ a first object and هدى a second object; ﴿لبني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هدى﴾; and إسرائيل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ألا تتخذوا من دوني وكيلا﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what it governs as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "that you should not take", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿كتبنا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no كتبنا in this ayah — presumably آتينا is meant]. The clause ﴿لا تتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya an, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; ﴿وكيلًا﴾ is the first object of تتخذوا; and ﴿من دوني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object of ﴿تتخذوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ذرية من حملنا مع نوح﴾: ذرية is made accusative by specification (ikhtiṣāṣ); it has been said: as a vocative; it has been said: as a badal (substitute) from ﴿وكيلًا﴾; and it has been said: as the second object of تتخذوا; ﴿مَن﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿حملنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملنا﴾, and نوح is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إنه كان عبدا شكورا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (nāsikh) and the hāʾ its noun (ism); كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; عبدًا is its khabar (predicate), and شكورًا a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وقضينا إلى بني إسرائيل في الكتاب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; قضينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى بني إسرائيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قضينا﴾; and ﴿في الكتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لتفسدن في الأرض مرتين﴾: the lām is the answer to the omitted oath, or the decisive decree is treated as an oath, as though it were said: "and We swore: you will surely cause corruption"; تفسدن is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the presence of the nūn, which has been elided because of the succession of nūns; the wāw of the plural, elided because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تفسدن﴾; ﴿مرتين﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its number, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ because it is dual.
﴿ولتعلن علوا كبيرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿لتعلن﴾ is conjoined to لتفسدن, and it is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the presence of the nūn, which has been elided because of the succession of nūns; the wāw of the plural, elided because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; ﴿علوًّا﴾ is an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq, and كبيرًا a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فإذا جاء وعد أولاهما بعثنا عليكم عبادا لنا أولي بأس شديد﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; إذا is a future adverb of time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿جاء﴾ is that to which the adverb is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi); ﴿وعد﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) and أولاهما muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and an omitted muḍāf must be supposed, i.e. "the promise of the punishment of the first of them"; the clause ﴿بعثنا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بعثنا﴾; عبادًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أولي﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عبادًا﴾; ﴿بأس﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿شديد﴾ is a naʿt of بأس. [Translator's note: the source does not parse لنا.]
﴿فجاسوا خلال الديار﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; جاسوا is conjoined to ﴿بعثنا﴾; ﴿خلال﴾ is an adverb of place attached to ﴿جاسوا﴾, and الديار is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وكان وعدا مفعولا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and its noun (ism) is a pronoun referring back to the promise of punishment; ﴿وعدًا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and مفعولًا a naʿt of ﴿وعدًا﴾; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Or the wāw is parenthetical, and the clause is a parenthesis between the two conjoined items, with no grammatical position. It has been said: the wāw conjoins to ﴿بعثنا﴾, and it has been said: it conjoins to ﴿فجاسوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ثم رددنا لكم الكرة عليهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; ﴿رددنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رددنا﴾; ﴿الكرة﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عليكم﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has عليهم] is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿الكرة﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from it.
﴿وأمددناكم بأموال وبنين وجعلناكم أكثر نفيرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أمددناكم is conjoined to ﴿رددنا﴾, and it is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بأموال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أمددناكم﴾; ﴿بنين﴾ is conjoined to أموال; ﴿جعلناكم﴾ is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أكثر﴾ is a second object; and نفيرًا is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿إن أحسنتم أحسنتم لأنفسكم وإن أسأتم فلها﴾: إن is conditional; أحسنتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿أحسنتم﴾ is its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿إن أسأتم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿إن أحسنتم﴾; the fāʾ links the answer; and ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then your evil-doing [is against them]". [Translator's note: the source does not parse لأنفسكم.]
